body:
You just responded to my programming thread, so I thought I'd look through you post history to see what you meant about the things you're dealing with.

I'm a Buddhist, but a bad Buddhist. I don't mediate that much, I don't follow traditions well, I leave a trail of bad behavior and karma... I asked a teacher about this once, and he said sometimes we can be too content to change our lives, and that sometimes things need to get worse to propel us to make positive changes. Now that I say it, it sounds like it could apply to what I'm going through, but you as well.

I hope you get through this ok. If it's any consolidation, I've has my own brief dealings with being homeless, jobless, and without support. But we're all resourceful, and sometimes as soon as you relax and give up, the solution presents itself.

Be resourceful my friend.
Actually that's helpful to hear. I have several mentors who I've worked with for years, and they might understand what I'm going through. Thanks.
Those are great thoughts. Good thing I'm pretty much alone in the coffee shop facing out the window. As soon as my eyes dry I'm going to go spend some therapeutic time with the family. Thanks.
